newsitem.title: USA: BPA leaves power offers unchanged for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: BPA leaves power offers unchanged for Thursday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left next-day power prices unchanged, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA continued to offer 100 megawatts of firm power during peak demand hours at $17.00 per megawatt (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $18.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA also continued to offer non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 at $8.00 per MWh.
Non-firm power for hours ending 0600 and 2300-2400 on Thursday was offered at $10.00, while prices for hours ending 0700-0800 were steady at $13.00 for Northwest sales and $14.00 for COB.
